purpose: Define callisto init's generated GitHub Actions release workflow for workspaces with a build-matrix need: the plan/build/execute job sequence, the build job's matrix construction from callisto matrix and from [[release.artifact]] slots, the per-target build and artifact-placement commands, and callisto matrix's own extension to enumerate cargo release-artifact entries.
scope: Workflow generation for a workspace configuring napi platform packages (per IdentityIndex::attached_platforms) or [[release.artifact]] slots: the plan job, the build job's matrix construction and per-target build/upload commands, the artifact-placement step, and the execute job's commands. Reuses SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE's file path, no-overwrite/dry-run rule, --workflow/--no-workflow mutual exclusivity, mode input, and per-job permission/secret model rather than redefining them. Depends on SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE for those shared mechanics, on SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE for the triggering question/flags and the ResolvedConfig facts that route generation here instead of to SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE, and on SPEC-DX-RELEASE-CLI for the callisto release plan, callisto release artifact-manifest, and callisto release execute subcommands this spec's jobs invoke. Depends on callisto matrix's report schema (crates/callisto-model/src/matrix.rs's MatrixReport/PlatformTargetGroup/PlatformTarget) for the platformTargets shape AC-002's flattening query reads.
non_goals: The no-build-matrix two-job shape, file path, no-overwrite/dry-run rule, mode input definition, and per-job permissions/secrets -- SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE's territory, reused here by reference rather than redefined.
init's detection, questions, non-interactive flags, and config write -- SPEC-DX-SETUP-CORE's territory.
callisto release plan/artifact-manifest/execute's own flag surface, exit codes, and output schema beyond the exact command lines this spec's jobs run -- SPEC-DX-RELEASE-CLI's territory.
A maturin build path: the build-job matrix query filters platformTargets to kind=="napi" only (AC-002); no job is generated for maturin platform packages.
A recovery-job, coordinator-job, or any SHA-based release-candidate-detection step -- explicitly excluded by design; callisto release's own execution-time idempotency is relied on instead.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The generated file's plan job runs callisto release plan to produce the release intent consumed by the build and execute jobs.

The build job's matrix is populated by flattening callisto matrix --format json output with .platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="napi") | .targets[]; each resulting matrix entry's job declares runs-on: <entry.hostRunner> and passes --use-cross to its build command when entry.useCross is true.
Each napi matrix entry's build job runs napi build --platform --release --target <entry.triple> and includes an artifact-upload step for the resulting build output.

The build job's matrix additionally includes one entry per [[release.artifact]] slot from the release intent's artifactSlots; each such entry's job runs cargo build --release --target <triple> and archives the result to that slot's configured asset name.

callisto matrix --format json's platformTargets output includes an entry for each configured [[release.artifact]] cargo binary, sourced from the workspace's resolved [[release.artifact]] config, alongside its existing napi and maturin entries.

[UPDATED 2026-09-24] The `napi artifacts` placement step runs inside the execute job itself -- after the intent/napi-artifact downloads and before `release artifact-manifest`/`release execute` -- not as a separate job between the build jobs and the execute job; there is no standalone placement job.

[UPDATED 2026-09-24] The execute job runs `callisto release artifact-manifest` only when `has_artifacts == 'true'`, so a napi-only workspace (with no artifact slots) skips it; `callisto release execute` runs afterward and receives `--artifact-manifest` only when the manifest file exists. When artifact-manifest does run, it precedes execute.
The build-matrix generated file also contains a version-pr job invoking callisto-action with mode omitted or set to version-pr, matching SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE AC-004's version-pr job.

The build-matrix generated file contains no recovery-job, coordinator-job, or SHA-based release-candidate-detection step, and applies no commit-SHA gating. Its plan job's only gate is a content precondition: the first step checks whether the pushed commit added or modified .callisto/release-decision.json relative to its first parent (the file callisto release plan --from-release-commit requires that commit to write) and sets an output, and every later plan step and the build and execute jobs run only when it did. The 40-line cap from SPEC-DX-SETUP-WORKFLOW-SIMPLE AC-004 does not apply to this generated file.

reasoning: No api_surface: interface is generated YAML content, not a callable signature. MatrixReport/PlatformTargetGroup/PlatformTarget field names (platformTargets, kind, targets, hostRunner, useCross, triple) confirmed via git show origin/main:crates/callisto-model/src/matrix.rs; napi/maturin are the only two PlatformTargetKind variants today, with no cargo/[[release.artifact]] representation yet, which is what AC-005 adds. callisto matrix's own command signature confirmed via git show origin/main:crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/matrix.rs. Trust model (owner-default decision, wave 7b review): a merge to the protected default branch is the release approval, as in prior art; init states it after writing the workflow (workflow-merge-publishes info diagnostic) instead of generating an environment or reviewer gate.
